dict.string: This app uses Bluetooth to connect and communicate with your Mindora device to sync health data.
This app uses Bluetooth to connect and communicate with your Mindora device to sync health data.
Mindora needs access to your camera to take a profile picture.

Mindora reads your heart rate, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, respiratory rate, body temperature and sleep data from Health to show you personalized sleep insights. It is never used for advertising and is never shared with third parties.
Mindora only reads Health data to generate your sleep insights and does not write any data to Health.
Mindora uses the local network to discover and connect to your devices.
Mindora needs location access to help you quickly fill in your address.
Mindora needs permission to save screenshots to your photo library.
Mindora needs permission to access your photo library to select a profile picture or save images.
